# Restore architectural conviction and platform-first positioning across learn/benefits/body/* and learn/README.md (#20509, #20507)

## Context

PR `#20509` (`#20508`, merged at `d6006f42eb`) executed Row 10 (`over-claim-sweep`) of `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` across seven `learn/benefits/body/*.md` pages (`ApplicationEngine.md`, `ConfigSystem.md`, `Features.md`, `FormsEngine.md`, `FourEnvironments.md`, `ObjectPermanence.md`, `Quick.md`), and PR `#20507` (`#20503`, merged at `df66128496`) rewrote `learn/README.md` and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md`. In doing so, they conflated `.agents/skills/blog-post/references/blog-authoring-guide.md` §3 (which bans unsourced *external* blog stats, false universals, and second-person competitive put-downs) with a tone-policing sweep that watered down Neo.mjs's own architectural thesis and proven capabilities, while leaving the narrow "engineered for use cases where frameworks bottleneck" phrasing that reduced the apparent target audience by 98%+.

## The Problem

Operator review on `d6006f42eb` (`learn/benefits/body/ApplicationEngine.md` and siblings) and follow-up positioning direction (`#20518#issuecomment-6700350274`) identified two compounding defects:
1. **Tone-flattening of Neo.mjs's architectural conviction (`#20509` & `#20507`):**
   - `learn/benefits/body/ApplicationEngine.md`: replaced `40k+ ops/sec financial trading desks` (backed by `learn/benefits/body/Speed.md:27`'s `40,000+` delta updates/sec Helix benchmark), `## The Paradigm Shift: Why the Industry Must Adapt`, `To understand why Neo.mjs is the only platform truly ready for the AI era`, `Humans are the orchestrators; LLMs are the builders`, `physically impossible in legacy frameworks (like seamless multi-window browser apps)`, and `## Conclusion: Build the Impossible` with generic corporate prose.
   - Sibling `learn/benefits/body/*.md` pages (`ObjectPermanence.md`, `FourEnvironments.md`, `Features.md`, `ConfigSystem.md`, `FormsEngine.md`, `Quick.md`) and `learn/README.md` / `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` (`#20507`) stripped their paradigm-shift conviction headings and opening thesis sentences.
2. **Niche-only audience framing (`98%+` audience reduction, `#20518#issuecomment-6700350274`):**
   - Even before `#20509`, `ApplicationEngine.md:10` read *"It is engineered for use cases where legacy frameworks fatally bottleneck: 40k+ ops/sec financial trading desks, multi-window control rooms, and complex, data-intensive dashboards"* — implying developers only need Neo.mjs for exotic multi-window or trading apps.
   - In reality, Neo.mjs ships a complete, battery-included component library (**`326` UI component, layout, and interaction modules across `522` engine classes in `src/`**) at feature parity with Sencha Ext JS (and architected far beyond it), ready to build stunning desktop and mobile apps and replace Angular, React, or Vue for **any** web application — with **more and faster on top** (multi-threaded runtime, `40k+ ops/sec`, multi-window workspaces, `100,000`-row grids).

## The Architectural Reality

- Per `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §2 and operator direction (`#20518#issuecomment-6700350274`):
  - Guides and benefit pages are **conviction-driven hero pieces** (*"The test: a human should want to try Neo after reading"*).
  - Lead with the **complete application platform** first (`326` UI component/layout/interaction modules across `522` `src/**/*.mjs` engine classes at feature parity with [Sencha Ext JS](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/comparisons/NeoVsExtJs.md) and beyond, replacing Angular, React, or Vue for any desktop or mobile application), then present the engine-class capabilities (`40,000+` delta updates/sec per `Speed.md:27`, `100,000`-row buffered grids, live cross-window component mobility on a `SharedWorker` heap, zero-build ES modules, and live runtime possession over the `Neural Link`) as **more and faster on top**.

Design authority: Operator feedback on `#20509` + operator positioning direction (`#20518#issuecomment-6700350274`, `2026-11-07`) + `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §2.

## The Fix

1. **Restore full architectural conviction across `learn/benefits/body/*.md`, `learn/README.md`, and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md`:**
   - Revert the tone-flattening edits from `d6006f42eb` across `ApplicationEngine.md`, `ObjectPermanence.md`, `FourEnvironments.md`, `Features.md`, `ConfigSystem.md`, `FormsEngine.md`, and `Quick.md`.
   - Restore the conviction thesis in `learn/README.md` and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` while keeping the Two Hemispheres, Three Reader Paths, 10-section `learn/tree.json` table, `<details>` widget, and runnable `live-preview` examples from `#20507`.
   - In `learn/benefits/body/ApplicationEngine.md:45`, link the [Neural Link Guide](../../agentos/NeuralLink.md) and name both the **Agent OS** (`neomjs/neo-agent-brain`) and the **Fleet Manager** (`neomjs/neo-agent-institution`) while keeping the original closing punch.
2. **Add the platform-first audience positioning line (`#20518#issuecomment-6700350274`):**
   - Update `learn/benefits/body/ApplicationEngine.md:10`, `learn/README.md:5`, and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md:3` to lead with the complete application platform (`326` UI component, layout, and interaction modules across `522` engine classes in `src/` at feature parity with Sencha Ext JS and beyond — ready for any desktop or mobile app and easily replacing Angular, React, or Vue — with **more and faster on top**: `40k+ ops/sec` trading desks, multi-window control rooms, and `100,000`-row dashboards).
3. **[x] Record the rule boundary on `#20498`:**
   - Completed in place on `#20498` body and `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` (`#issuecomment-6700210202`).

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] **AC-1 (Conviction, Platform-First Audience Line & `ApplicationEngine.md:45` Naming):** Restores all original headings, `40k+ ops/sec financial trading desks`, `Humans are the orchestrators; LLMs are the builders`, `physically impossible in legacy frameworks`, and `Build the Impossible` across the 7 `learn/benefits/body/` files plus `learn/README.md` and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md`; adds the platform-first audience positioning (`326` UI component/layout/interaction modules across `522` `src/` classes, Sencha Ext JS parity and beyond, replacing Angular/React/Vue for any desktop or mobile app, with `40k+ ops/sec` / multi-window / `100,000`-row grids on top) in `ApplicationEngine.md:10`, `learn/README.md:5`, and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md:3`; and names the Agent OS (`neomjs/neo-agent-brain`) and Fleet Manager (`neomjs/neo-agent-institution`) in `ApplicationEngine.md:45`.
- [x] **AC-2 (Link & Whitespace Integrity):** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass with `0` errors, and `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` / `apps/portal/llms.txt` remain untouched.

## Out of Scope

Modifying `learn/tree.json` or `apps/portal/` JS views.

## Avoided Traps

- Treating `blog-authoring-guide.md` §3 (unsourced external stats) as a ban on stating Neo.mjs's own architectural paradigm shift or measured `40k+ ops/sec` delta-update throughput.
- Framing Neo.mjs as only needed for exotic multi-window or trading apps instead of a complete application platform (`326` UI modules across `522` engine classes) that replaces Angular, React, or Vue for any desktop or mobile app while delivering more and faster on top.

### @neo-fable-clio - 2026-11-07T01:29:08Z

**The audience line — the maintainer's claim, written from the repository (dev f12b3676ff, Sat Nov 7 02:5x CET; corrected 03:1x and 03:2x).** Provenance: the operator's merge-gate read of #20509 — the page had narrowed Neo to multi-threaded niches. The claim below is written from the inventory, not from his sentence; every number reproduces with the rule beside it.

**The counting rule (one rule, stated once, used everywhere):** a *class* is a file under `src/` that calls `Neo.setupClass` (`grep -rl Neo.setupClass src --include='*.mjs' | wc -l`); `_export.mjs` barrels, mixins-only files and non-class modules do not count. A *field type* is a class under `src/form/field/` outside `trigger/` and the internals (`chip/`, `fileUpload/`), `Base` excluded. Counting files instead of classes gives 520 / 42 / 10 and is wrong on a public page.

**Inventory** (`git rev-list --count HEAD`, `ls`):

| What | Count | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Classes | **459** in 39 namespaces (520 files, 24 of them barrels) | `src/` |
| Form field types | **26** — CheckBox, Chip, Color, ComboBox, Country, Currency, Date, Display, Email, FileUpload, Hidden, IBAN, Number, Password, Phone, Picker, Radio, Range, Search, Select, Switch, Text, TextArea, Time, Url, ZipCode; nested forms | `src/form/field/` |
| Grid | **38** classes — locked columns, header groups (`header/GroupRow`), cell editing, animated rows, tree / sparkline / progress / currency columns, buffered rows to **100,000** | `src/grid/`, `examples/grid/bigData` |
| Calendar 28 · dashboard docking 44 · selection models 24 · draggable 14 · data 17 · list 9 · tab 7 · table 6 | | `src/*` |
| Layouts | **8** — Card, Cube, Fit, Flexbox, Form, Grid, HBox, VBox | `src/layout/` |
| Main-thread addons | **38** — AmCharts, GoogleMaps, MapboxGL, OpenStreetMaps, CesiumJS, MonacoEditor, Markdown, Mermaid, HighlightJS, ServerSideRendering, ServiceWorker, WebComponent, FileSystemAccess, LocalStorage, DragDrop, Popover, … | `src/main/addon/` |
| Throughput · windows | **40,000+** delta updates per second (`learn/benefits/body/Speed.md:27`) · multi-window on one SharedWorker heap (`src/worker/`) | |
| Commits **27,761** · examples 38 · apps 14 · unit specs 609 | | |

**The public inventory and the comparisons already exist:** `learn/guides/fundamentals/CodebaseOverview.md` §"Component Library (The Batteries)" (lines 255–290) lists the families as of "State of May 1, 2026" — 20+ field types where the tree has 26, no dashboard docking, no header groups; its refresh with the rule above is a learn-map leaf. `learn/comparisons/` (six pages, the tree's "Engine vs Frameworks") carries the positioning against React, Angular, Vue, Solid, Next and Ext JS; `NeoVsExtJs.md` §5 states the parity claim on the record — *"Its component library achieves feature parity with many of Ext.js's offerings, but with technically superior, modular, and more performant implementations"* — and concludes "a modern successor to Ext.js". The Knowledge Base ranks the overview first for "what does Neo ship" and then answers "not enough information" — a synthesis defect of `ask_knowledge_base`, not of the corpus (defect-note 78a07f7b to the Brain). By grep, none of `ApplicationEngine.md`, `Features.md`, `Quick.md` named Angular, React, Vue, Ext JS or mobile before tonight — the benefit pages never stated the audience, and never linked the comparisons that argue it; that defect predates #20509.

**The paragraph that replaces "It is engineered for use cases where legacy frameworks fatally bottleneck: …" in `learn/benefits/body/ApplicationEngine.md` (one headline number, capabilities named, the proofs linked; the per-family counts live in the PR body and the overview, not in a hero paragraph):**

> Neo.mjs is a complete application platform: 459 classes in 39 namespaces — a grid with locked columns, header groups, cell editing and 100,000-row buffering; a form engine with 26 field types and nested forms; calendar, dashboard docking, tabs, dialogs, toolbars, menus, lists and trees; eight layouts; 38 main-thread addons for charts, maps, Monaco, Markdown, Mermaid, service workers and server-side rendering; data stores, state providers, selection models and routing. It builds the applications teams build with [Angular, React or Vue](../../comparisons/Overview.md) today, at [feature parity with Ext JS](../../comparisons/NeoVsExtJs.md) and beyond it in architecture, for desktop and mobile browsers. And it goes where those cannot: a multi-threaded runtime that keeps 40,000+ delta updates per second off the main thread, multi-window applications on one shared worker heap, grids that never freeze.

**`learn/README.md`, first sentence:** "Neo.mjs is a complete application platform — 459 classes from grid to forms to calendar to dashboards — for every desktop and mobile web application, with a multi-threaded runtime that goes where single-threaded libraries cannot."

**Corrected at 03:2x:** my earlier "parity stays the operator's word until a family-by-family comparison exists" was wrong — the comparison exists and makes the claim; I had not listed `learn/`. The sentence carries the parity claim with its link. What remains honest: no example is captioned as a mobile proof (touch handling lives in `DragDrop` / `GridDragScroll`; there is no `examples/*mobile*`) — a catalog row for #20498, not a sentence on this page beyond "desktop and mobile browsers". The counts drift with every release: the PR body carries the commands, the Dec 1 page re-counts.

**Where it lands:** #20519 (approved at bc7a5384c4; the links are one more push). Both pages are 13.4 gate items (#20496).
